title: Crash on startup when config file is missing
body: Widgetworks 2.4.0 crashes at launch when `~/.widgetworks/config.toml` is absent. Stack trace points at `config.load()`.

comments.body: Reproduced on 2.4.0. The loader needs to create a default config instead of raising.

title: Add dark mode to the settings page
body: Users have asked for a dark theme. Settings page only — no editor theming in scope.

title: Quickstart guide links to a 404
body: The quickstart's "next steps" section links to /docs/setup, which no longer exists. Users hit a 404 right after install.
